For what value of $n$ are the $n$th terms of the APs $63, 65, 67, \dots$ and $3, 10, 17, \dots$ equal?
The 6th term of an AP is zero. Prove that its 26th term is twice its 16th term.

Meera deposits ₹$12000$ in a scheme that pays simple interest at $6\%$ per year. Write the amount (principal plus interest) in her account at the end of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd years. Show that these amounts form an AP and find the amount at the end of $20$ years.

The sum of three numbers in AP is $27$ and the sum of their squares is $293$. Find the numbers. Taking these as the first three terms of an AP, find the sum of its first $15$ terms in each possible case.
The sum of the first $7$ terms of an AP is $91$ and the sum of its first $16$ terms is $424$. Find the sum of its first $n$ terms, and hence find $S_{20}$.
In an AP, the sum of the first $p$ terms is $q$ and the sum of the first $q$ terms is $p$, where $p \ne q$. Prove that the sum of its first $(p + q)$ terms is $-(p + q)$.

The plots in a housing colony are numbered $1, 2, 3, \dots, 1681$ in a row. Show that there is a plot numbered $x$ such that the sum of the numbers of the plots before it equals the sum of the numbers of the plots after it. Find $x$ and this common sum.

text: A gardener waters $12$ flower pots placed in a straight line along a path, as shown in the figure. The tap is at the start of the path, the first pot is $5$ m from the tap and each later pot is $3$ m beyond the previous one. He fills one can at the tap, waters one pot, and walks back to the tap before watering the next pot.

text: A bakery gives its customers token numbers that are the three-digit multiples of $17$, used in increasing order: $102, 119, 136, \dots$. Each three-digit multiple of $17$ is used exactly once in a day, and the day ends when they run out.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: How many tokens are given out in a day?

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Find the 10th token number from the end, and the sum of the first $10$ token numbers.

text: Ramesh borrows ₹$63000$ from a cooperative society and repays it in $12$ monthly instalments. The first instalment is ₹$2500$ and each instalment is ₹$500$ more than the one before it. There is no interest.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: How much does he still owe after paying $7$ instalments?

text: A school library adds new books every year, and the number added each year forms an AP. It added $520$ books in the 4th year and $870$ books in the 9th year.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: How many books were added in the 1st year?

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: How many books will be added in the 12th year?

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Find the total number of books added in the first $10$ years.
